jobs.title: Manufacturing Safety, Health, and Environmental Specialist
jobs.description:
Role:
Safety Health & Environmental Specialist

Responsibilities Include

Leading EHS programs to ensure a safe, compliant, and sustainable work environment
Conducting risk assessments and safety audits to identify and mitigate hazards
Investigating incidents and implementing corrective actions
Delivering safety and environmental training to staff
Managing regulatory documentation, permits, and compliance requirements
Partnering with plant operations to embed safe work practices and support sustainability initiatives
Reducing waste and fostering a strong safety culture across all shifts and teams

Qualifications And Skills

Knowledge of safety, health, and environmental regulations
Strong audit, investigation, and risk assessment skills
Excellent communication and training abilities
Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams
Commitment to safety, sustainability, and continuous improvement

Show less

Seniority level

Not Applicable

Employment type

Full-time

Industries
